description: Morphe patches for BitChord 1.9: music from your own Telegram channels, download-only Soulseek audio, and optional playback tools. Runs on your phone using your own accounts; doesn't unlock premium features.

patches.name: Battery saver
patches.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: DJ mode
patches.description: Picks the next song in the queue for a neighbouring key and a close tempo. Keys and tempos are learned as songs play. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Equaliser per output
patches.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Headphone correction
patches.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

options.description: The app name on your home screen, up to 80 characters. Leave blank for Bitchord+. A name containing Telegram must include Unofficial Telegram.

patches.name: JamesDSP
patches.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Loudness level
patches.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Per-download quality
patches.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Pitch control
patches.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches.name: Sing
patches.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches.description: Download selected Soulseek or debrid audio to a phone folder, a configured Telegram main channel, or both. Optional debrid services use your own API keys. Choose accepted formats and their order in setup. Live playback and automatic source matching are disabled. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

options.description: Leave at 0 and enter your API ID in the app after installing.
Leave empty and enter your API hash in the app after installing.

release_notes:
# 1.1.0-beta.8

This testing release combines the BitChord 1.9 compatibility work with the
Unofficial Soulseek audio patch and its download tools. It targets the released
BitChord 1.9 phone APKs on Android 8 / API 26 or newer.

- **Patches & tweaks** opens from BitChord's redesigned Settings page. Soulseek,
  peer downloads, debrid services, copy destinations and format preferences
  remain nested under that page. The managed download entries stay out of the
  Sources page.
- **Soulseek downloads** retain the chosen source file, format preferences and
  copy destinations. The download-route adapter handles BitChord 1.9's changed
  constructor and optimized coroutine layouts. Cancellation marks queued
  selections before interrupting an active transfer.
- **Debrid downloads** retain independent Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize and
  TorBox switches. Each service starts disabled and uses the user's own API key.
  Provider cards start collapsed, expand one at a time, and use the themed
  switch and existing settings gear. Disabled providers hide their controls and
  disable the gear. First enable waits for a successful encrypted key save.
- **Peer downloads** retain Nostr coordination, direct UDP / QUIC transfer and
  the Tor, I2P and IPFS fallback runtimes. They remain download features.
- **Telegram downloads** handle the source probe introduced in BitChord 1.9
  using indexed file information. Channel playlists handle the new song field.
- **Smooth quality switching** handles BitChord 1.9's version-alignment
  parameters. Sing, headphone correction and DJ analysis cover Automix's
  separately rendered loop-mix audio paths.
- **Bit-perfect output** is reflected in the effects page. Sleep timers pause
  without an unavailable software-volume fade, Battery saver stands down, and
  the page identifies effects that do not reach that output.
- **DJ mode** waits for an active Automix transition before rearranging the queue.

Explicit Telegram and Soulseek file selections retain their original encoding;
the per-download quality chooser applies to catalogue downloads. A format label
or encoding probe cannot prove that a lossless file was never transcoded.

The patch bundle includes arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 runtimes. Selecting
Soulseek on the BitChord 1.9 universal APK removes its unsupported 32-bit x86
native directory; that patched APK supports the three complete architectures.

This is a testing build. Automated checks do not qualify physical-device audio,
real provider accounts, public relay/NAT/overlay connectivity or Android
lifecycle behavior. See the [known limitations](https://github.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/blob/testing/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) and
[download testing guide](https://github.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/blob/testing/docs/SOULSEEK-TESTING.md).

- **Translations:** Soulseek, debrid and peer-transfer pages follow BitChord's selected language across all 20 supported translations, including RTL layout and download notifications.
- **UI review:** screenshots and screen recording are enabled across beta.8, including setup pages and dialogs; other builds default to protection.
